title: KaTeX math + callout directives (info, insight, warning, danger)
description: Verifies the Theory widget's KaTeX math rendering (inline + display) and the four supported callout tones via `:::callout{type=...}` directives.

sections.title: Inline math — Greek letters, subscripts, fractions

data.markdown:
## Inline math

The variance of a random variable $X$ with mean $\mu$ is $\sigma^{2} = E[(X - \mu)^{2}]$, so its standard deviation is $\sigma = \sqrt{\sigma^{2}}$.

A sample mean over $n$ observations is written $\bar{x} = \tfrac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i$, and its standard error is $\tfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$.

If any of the symbols above render as raw LaTeX source like `\mu` instead of μ, KaTeX is not running.

sections.title: Display math — equations on their own line

data.markdown:
## Display math

The Gaussian density is

\[
G(x; \mu, \sigma) = \frac{1}{\sigma \sqrt{2\pi}}\, \exp\!\left(-\frac{(x - \mu)^{2}}{2 \sigma^{2}}\right)
\]

The softmax over a logit vector $z \in \mathbb{R}^{K}$ is

\[
\mathrm{softmax}(z)_{i} = \frac{e^{z_i}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K} e^{z_j}} \quad \text{for } i = 1, \ldots, K.
\]

And the cross-entropy between distributions $p$ and $q$ is

\[
H(p, q) = -\sum_{x} p(x) \log q(x).
\]

Display equations should be centred and have generous vertical breathing room.

sections.title: Callout directives — the four supported tones

data.markdown:
## Callout tones

The Theory widget understands `:::callout{type="..."}` directives with four tones: `info`, `insight`, `warning`, `danger`. Each renders with a tinted background, an icon, and an optional title.

:::callout{type="info" title="Info"}
Neutral context that supports the main narrative — definitions, links, footnote-style asides.
:::

:::callout{type="insight" title="Insight"}
A non-obvious observation worth highlighting — the kind of thing a tutor would underline in the margin of a textbook.
:::

:::callout{type="warning" title="Warning"}
A gotcha or pitfall the learner should actively avoid. Stronger visual weight than info/insight.
:::

:::callout{type="danger" title="Danger"}
Reserved for hard correctness or safety issues — code that would silently corrupt data, security footguns, etc.
:::

## Callout without an explicit title

:::callout{type="info"}
When no title attribute is provided, the callout still renders — the title row is simply omitted.
:::
